duration: 2 to 3 hours a week. Commit to at least one session, preferably a year.
name: Teen Tutor and Session Lead Volunteers
city: Libraries in Texas and Pennsylvania (ask which one has a chapter)
what_you_do: Tutor 4 to 5 kindergarten to 3rd grade students in math using the OneInMath lessons. The program is run with libraries. You earn volunteer hours.
who_can_apply: Tutors are ages 13 to 18, love working with young kids, have a B or higher in high school math, and bring a laptop.
deadline_text: No deadline stated. Register to volunteer on the site.
how_to_apply: Sign up to volunteer on the OneInMath site. Use the register-volunteer page.
notes: The pages read do not list chapter locations. The tutor page's library news mentions North Texas libraries, so ask the group which library near you has a chapter.
